title: Colorful Badges & New Tailwind Colors
summary: Badge gets the same colors and styles as the Tag Group, and both support Tailwind's new taupe, mauve, mist and olive colors.
body:
- [**Badge**](/components/badge): New `soft`, `solid` and `modern` variants and a `color` prop with 30 colors (`primary`, the whole Tailwind palette, the `error`/`warning`/`success` aliases and the new `taupe`, `mauve`, `mist` and `olive`). `outline` can now be colored too. Also new: `shape` (`rounded` or `pill`), `icon`, `trailing-icon`, `dot`, `avatar` and the `leading` and `trailing` slots. Every existing variant and prop looks and works exactly as before. The colors live in `~/utils/badge-colors`, which is installed with the badge.
- [**Tag Group**](/components/tag-group): Now supports the same 30 colors and shares them with the Badge. The hover and selected states no longer depend on the color of the tag, and `UiTagGroup` and `UiTagGroupItem` need the new `badge-colors` util. Update with `ui-thing@latest add tag-group badge`.
